column1: # What a button invokes, as HTML's button activation resolves it: exact_kernel::Invocation and host/apple/Sources/ExactKit/Invocation.swift.
# kernel/tests/it/invocation.rs and InvocationTests.swift both read this file. Each builds the `element`s under one root, applies the `rename`s in order,

# with each `paragraph` holding its `run`s (inline text: run id, paragraph id, props), then adds each `case`'s source (a button, a native button or a view) as a new child and checks what it invokes: target id and action, or `-` for nothing,
# and whether that opens a popover (a header's menu button). Props are `name=value` separated by `;`. Among elements that share an id, a view is named before
# an inline run, then the lowest node id.

column6: a commandfor that names an element wins
an empty one falls back, and its leftover command is ignored
one naming a non-popover: no fallback
show-modal on a popover that is no dialog
show-modal on a dialog that is also a popover is no menu
popovertarget on a dialog popover toggles it
popovertarget naming a dialog without popover
duplicate ids: the lowest node id
duplicate ids: the lowest node id, whatever order the ids were set in
a view is named before an inline run, whatever their ids
one naming an inline run names an element: no fallback
an inline run is no popover, whatever it says
